checked_classes: Spec violations — the diff implements the mounted session path, sanitized response, fresh Kratos validation, Postgres-backed membership, explicit 401/403/503 semantics, inactive desktop wrapper, and pooled transaction scoping required by the acceptance criteria.

Correctness — credential-source rejection, expiry checks, practice selection, membership denial, transaction completion, provider response bounds, and authorization revision updates have explicit paths without an identified logic defect in the packet.
Regressions — clean-checkout composition remains available through UnavailableSessions, existing clinical adapters remain unchanged, and the desktop counterpart stays inactive as required.

Security — caller identity hints are unused, credentials do not serialize, provider redirects and response size are bounded, database reads use a checked non-owner/non-bypass role with transaction-local identity context, and responses disable caching.

Constraint breaches — the diff preserves shell neutrality, clinical-principal separation, three evidence states, generated theme outputs, and the no-query-cache rule; added Rust dependencies are exact pins.

Silent failure — partial runtime configuration fails startup, provider and database failures map to Unavailable, malformed or ambiguous credentials are rejected, and membership absence maps to PracticeDenied rather than a permissive fallback.
